slides.title:
The most expensive hour
of an outage is the *first*.
The bridge
slides.body:
Fourteen people, most of
whom don't need to be there.

slides.title: In sequence
slides.body:
Network: clean interfaces.
App team: responds on localhost.
Storage: green.

slides.title: The result
slides.body:
Everybody is *correct*
and nothing is fixed.

slides.title: Why
slides.body:
Nobody can assign the problem,
so everybody defends against
*being assigned it*.

slides.title: The split
slides.body:
Ownership is a *role*,
at minute zero.
Cause is a *finding*, days later.

slides.title: The default
steps: it resolves to a *name*, not a debate.
Getting it wrong costs minutes. Debating costs the hour.

slides.title:
The first hour decides
whether the next three
have an *owner*.
slides.body:
Not where you
find the cause.

Follow *@mzsnetworks*
